grh_f4fbecf85866dd6e0acd.title: The Skys the Limit
paragraphs: Decorated fighter pilot Jerry Burton comes home on leave and, tired of being treated as a public hero, hides his identity while enjoying New York as an ordinary man. He falls for magazine photographer Jean, but his evasiveness and apparently aimless behavior make her believe he is wasting his life while editor Phil also hopes to marry her. Jerry cannot tell her that his leave is ending and that he is returning to combat. Phil sends Jean to photograph departing fighter pilots, and at the airfield she finally discovers who Jerry really is. They confess their love just before his transport takes off, with Jean promising to wait for him until the war is over.
